# Model weights: licences for v0.1.0-beta

<!-- Generated by tools/build_weights_licences.py from models/model_registry.json and
docs/model_licences/*.md. Edit those, then run: python -m tools.build_weights_licences -->

OpenDroneKit's source code is MIT. **The MIT licence covers the code only.** Each set of
model weights ships under its own licence terms, inherited from the base model it was
fine-tuned from and the data it was trained on, with that licence's text
(`LICENSES/<key>.txt`) and attribution (`docs/model_licences/<key>.md`) beside it.

The rule applied: a model ships under its own terms, and is held back only if its licence
forbids redistribution outright, or if no single set of terms can satisfy its inputs.

Weights are never committed to this repository. Published weights are GitHub Release
assets of `v0.1.0-beta`, and the first-run downloader installs a file only if it hashes to
the sha256 recorded in the registry. The app shows each model's licence as a badge
(Commercial OK / Copyleft AGPL / Non-commercial) in Run Model and Prelabel.

This is an engineering record, not legal advice.

#### Caveat

torchvision's documentation says: "The pre-trained models provided in this library may
have their own licenses or terms and conditions derived from the dataset used for
training." The ImageNet terms restrict the *images* to "non-commercial research and
educational purposes" (https://image-net.org/download.php). Whether those terms reach
weights initialised from an ImageNet-trained backbone is not settled. This was not treated
as a blocker; a commercial user with a low tolerance for risk should make their own
assessment.

#### Training data: each source's terms, as read on 2026-10-03

Corpus `crack_seg` = `crack_segmentation_kaggle` + `deepcrack` + `crackforest`
(`training/datasets/prepare.py`). The Kaggle set aggregates public crack sets, named by
file prefix.

| Source | Terms found | Clause | Bars distributing trained weights? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kaggle aggregate `lakshaymiddha/crack-segmentation-dataset` (from `khanhha/crack_segmentation`) | Kaggle licence field "Unknown"; the GitHub repository has no licence | khanhha README: "please cite the corresponding papers when using these datasets." | No clause found |
| CFD / CrackForest (`cuilimeng/CrackForest-dataset`) | Non-commercial research | README: "The dataset is made available for non-commercial research purposes only." | No |
| DeepCrack (`yhlleo/DeepCrack`) | Non-commercial research and education | README: "we own the copyrights to part of original crack images and all annotated maps. Their use is RESTRICTED to non-commercial research and educational purposes." | No. The provenance manifest's earlier "MIT (repository)" described the code, not the data. |
| CRACK500 (`fyangneil/pavement-crack-detection`) | No licence stated; the repository has no licence | README: "please cite the corresponding papers when using these datasets." | No clause found |
| GAPs384 (TU Ilmenau GAPs) | Academic use only | Request form, "Terms and Conditions of Usage": "publicly available for academic use only ... Any commercial distribution or act related to the commercial usage of this database is strictly prohibited. The distribution of this database to any parties that have not read and agreed to the terms and conditions of usage is strictly prohibited." | No. The bar is on distributing the database, not trained models; the commercial bar is honoured by the non-commercial release. |
| Rissbilder, Volker (via `alexdonchuk/cracks_segmentation_dataset`) | CC BY 4.0 (repository LICENSE) | Attribution required | No |
| AEL (Amhaz, Chambon et al.) | No licence found; the hosting page (irit.fr/~Sylvie.Chambon) now returns 404 | none found | No clause found |
| CrackTree200 (Zou et al.) | No licence found | none found | No clause found |

Sources with no stated licence are not treated as cleared for anything beyond what their
authors published. The weights are released non-commercially, and no image is
redistributed.

#### Attribution

- CRACK500: Zhang, L., Yang, F., Zhang, Y. D., Zhu, Y. J. "Road crack detection using deep
  convolutional neural network", ICIP 2016; Yang, F. et al. "Feature Pyramid and

- GAPs384: Eisenbach, M. et al. "How to Get Pavement Distress Detection Ready for Deep

- CFD / CrackForest: Shi, Y., Cui, L., Qi, Z., Meng, F., Chen, Z. "Automatic road crack

- CrackTree200: Zou, Q. et al. "CrackTree: Automatic crack detection from pavement images",

- DeepCrack: Liu, Y., Yao, J., Lu, X., Xie, R., Li, L. "DeepCrack: A Deep Hierarchical
  Feature Learning Architecture for Crack Segmentation", Neurocomputing 338, 2019.
- Rissbilder, Volker: `alexdonchuk/cracks_segmentation_dataset`, CC BY 4.0.
- Aggregation: `khanhha/crack_segmentation`; Kaggle `lakshaymiddha/crack-segmentation-dataset`.
- SegFormer, NVIDIA, NVIDIA Source Code License for SegFormer.

#### Training data and its terms, as read on 2026-10-03

PVEL-AD (Hebei University of Technology and Beihang University),
https://github.com/binyisu/PVEL-AD. The repository's Apache-2.0 LICENSE covers the code.
The data is released through the "Industrial Datasets Request Form"
(`Industrial_Data_Access_Form.docx` in that repository), which says:

> The datasets can ONLY be used for research and academic purposes.

The form also has the requester accept "the data license/agreement document". No such
separate agreement is published in the repository or on the request page; the form is the
only text of the terms found. Since 2026-01-30 the README also links a public Google Drive
download. If the agreement document is ever published and forbids distributing derived
models, this asset must be withdrawn.

#### Attribution

- Binyi Su, Zhong Zhou, Haiyong Chen. "PVEL-AD: A Large-Scale Open-World Dataset for
  Photovoltaic Cell Anomaly Detection". IEEE Transactions on Industrial Informatics.
  doi:10.1109/TII.2022.3162846.
- Ultralytics YOLO11 (https://github.com/ultralytics/ultralytics), AGPL-3.0.

(`license.id = other-nc`) and its `license.md`
(https://github.com/MrtnMndt/meta-learning-CODEBRIM/blob/master/license.md).

## Held back

Not published in v0.1.0-beta. Users can still run these from weights they obtain themselves; the registry rows and their sha256 checks are unchanged.

| Registry key | Clause or reason | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `shared_semantic_landcover` | CC BY-SA 4.0 and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 training data are mutually incompatible: each requires adaptations to be shared under the same licence, so no set of terms satisfies both. | retrain without the NC regions (the default corpus build, without --include-noncommercial), then publish under CC BY-SA 4.0. |

### `shared_semantic_landcover`

- **Status:** not published. Users may run weights they obtain themselves; the registry row
  and its sha256 check are unchanged.
- **Base model:** DINOv2 ViT-B/14, code and weights Apache-2.0
  (https://github.com/facebookresearch/dinov2).
- **Why held:** the training data mixes CC BY-SA 4.0 (SpaceNet 7; some OpenEarthMap regions)
  with CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (OpenEarthMap regions admitted by commit 8e06ab5c1,
  `--include-noncommercial`; https://open-earth-map.org/attribution.html). Each licence's
  ShareAlike clause binds adaptations to its own licence elements. CC BY-SA 4.0 §3(b)(1):
  "The Adapter's License You apply must be a Creative Commons license with the same
  License Elements, this version or later, or a BY-SA Compatible License." CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
  §3(b)(1) says the same with its own elements, which include NonCommercial. No licence
  carries both element sets, so no compliant terms exist for these weights.
- **Fix:** retrain without the NC regions (the default corpus build, without
  `--include-noncommercial`), then publish under CC BY-SA 4.0.

## OWNER GATE: AGPL-3.0 weights trained on non-commercial data

**Open decision for the owner. Confirm or reject before the release is published.**

Ultralytics states that every YOLO fine-tune is AGPL-3.0 ("All Ultralytics YOLO trained models fall under the AGPL-3.0 License by default", https://www.ultralytics.com/license). AGPL-3.0 section 10 forbids imposing "any further restrictions on the exercise of the rights granted or affirmed under this License", and a non-commercial condition is such a restriction. So a YOLO fine-tune whose data or weight licence is non-commercial has no single set of terms that satisfies both. Neither licence forbids redistribution outright, so under the owner's rule these ship, flagged non-commercial, with both notices. `shared_semantic_landcover` was held for a comparable conflict (CC BY-SA vs CC BY-NC-SA); the difference is recorded here so the owner decides it explicitly.

| Registry key | Non-commercial terms | AGPL source | Status in this release |
|---|---|---|---|
| `powerline_insplad_detector` | InsPLAD weights and data, CC BY-NC 3.0. Card: "non-commercial use only ... weights are derivative works of the InsPLAD dataset" | Ultralytics YOLO11s fine-tune | arrives with Unit 5 (models/U5_infrastructure_detectors) |
| `powerline_insplad_condition` | InsPLAD weights and data, CC BY-NC 3.0. Card: "non-commercial use only ... weights are derivative works of the InsPLAD dataset" | Ultralytics YOLO11s fine-tune | arrives with Unit 5 (models/U5_infrastructure_detectors) |
| `solar_cell_defect_detector` | PVEL-AD (Hebei University of Technology and Beihang University), released through a signed request form: 'The datasets can ONLY be used for research and academic purposes.' | AGPL-3.0 (Ultralytics fine-tune) | published, flagged |
| `structural_multiclass_detector` | CODEBRIM (Goethe University / FIAS), Zenodo record 2620293, licence 'Other (Non-Commercial)'; used via the Roboflow export codebrim_structural | AGPL-3.0 (Ultralytics fine-tune) | published, flagged |

If the owner says **no**: remove the `download` entries of every row above (and set `licence.redistribution` to `"held"` with the reason), then rerun this tool. For power lines, `powerline_ttpla_yolo11s_seg` (AGPL-3.0, Apache-2.0 data, no conflict) then remains the only model.
